Calcutta High Court seeks clarification from Bengal government on mid-day meal proposal

The Calcutta High Court has sought an affidavit from the Bengal government regarding a proposed plan to provide mid-day meals to students by ISKCON. The court's move comes after it received a public interest litigation (PIL) on the matter. The Bengal government has stated that no decision has been taken yet on the proposal, but the court is seeking clarification on the issue.
